title: United States begins construction on new naval shipyard
excerpt: The facility is the first new shipyard to be established in more than eight decades and will focus on submarine production.
bodyHtml:
The White House announced on October 13, 2026, that construction has commenced on a new naval shipyard in the United States. This facility is the first of its kind to be built in more than eight decades and is intended to increase the nation's capacity for repairing submarines and aircraft carriers.

The project is part of a broader administration effort to expand the American shipbuilding industrial base. According to the White House, the administration has secured over $150 billion in investments for the shipbuilding industry, and a National Security Presidential Memorandum signed in August directs the Department of War to pursue further investments in the sector.

The new shipyard will specifically build the next generation of American submarines. The administration stated that these actions are intended to ensure the fleet is prepared to meet every challenge of the age.
